title: 150-year-overdue library book returned in Australia; racks up Rs 16 lakh 'late fee'
summary_full: A library received a book returned after 150 years overdue.  The calculated late fee reached approximately twenty-eight thousand Australian dollars.  This rare book was discovered during home renovations and was damaged.  It was borrowed by a local resident's great-great-grandfather in the 1870s.  The book will now join the library's local history collection.
